## Result and scope

This is a source-scope and prior-art audit of queue record **11000263 / AMR-109-0263**, Bigelow's Question 6. It makes **no new-discovery or priority claim**.

The literal published presentation invokes a terminal braid generator that is absent from the stated group. The package preserves that issue and states two explicit repairs. For each repair over Q(q), an already public Argus AI Team Burau construction proves X3 is nonzero for every applicable strand count. The original author's intended correction remains unconfirmed.

The audit credits the pinned public prior work and independently recomputes the algebra. It does not assert finite-dimensionality of a universal quotient or resolve neighboring questions.

## Independent adversarial review completed before this PR

A separate reviewer checked the exact audit and verifier at commit `2cafb4f09688c3cfde39cada3ae317c476832f2c`, independently inspected the primary source and prior-art archive, and issued **PASS with no mandatory mathematical revisions**. The original AUDIT.md and verify.py remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The current commit adds the review, its checks, and administrative status updates.

- [Audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/f8badd6b0766aff7d14504a17197fd487cfd53c6/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/11000263/AUDIT.md)
- [Independent review](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/f8badd6b0766aff7d14504a17197fd487cfd53c6/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/11000263/REVIEW.md)
- [Review verdict and exact hashes](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/f8badd6b0766aff7d14504a17197fd487cfd53c6/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/11000263/verdict.json)
- [Source attribution and search limits](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/f8badd6b0766aff7d14504a17197fd487cfd53c6/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/11000263/SOURCES.md)

This is independent AI review, not human peer review or formal certification. Execution used gpt-6-astra at xhigh reasoning.

## Validation

- 42 exact rational parameter/strand cases: **1,590 assertions passed**
- Separate symbolic implementation: **23 checks passed**
- Repository regression suite: **34 tests passed**, using temporary synthetic fixtures
- `git diff --check`: passed

Finite checks supplement the all-index proof. One exploratory proof approach was recorded before the exact prior-art hit; new-result search then stopped.

All changes are confined to `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/11000263/`. No shared queue, catalog, state, or historical review is changed. No third-party source PDF or verifier code is redistributed.
title: Audit Bigelow Question 6 prior art under two source repairs
